_meta.title: Nazis recruited by the US (Operation Paperclip) and Nazis who ended their lives abroad (Wikidata)
_meta.measures: (1) People Wikidata records as participants in Operation Paperclip (Q444698), placed at their US work location where recorded. (2) People Wikidata links to the ratlines (Q699862) - this includes authors who wrote about them; see 'description' and 'link_property'. (3) Nazi Party (Q7320) or SS/Waffen-SS members whose recorded place of death is in a Latin American country, Spain, Egypt or Syria, placed at that place. Group 3 is a factual selection by place of death; it does not by itself show that a person fled justice.
_meta.notes: Wikidata lists only 11 Paperclip participants; the programme brought over 1,600 people (figure on the site). A full list with locations would need US government records (e.g. NARA RG 330 JIOA files), which are not published as a dataset.
_meta.licence: Wikidata, CC0 1.0 ('All structured data ... is available under the Creative Commons CC0 License' - https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing)
_meta.spread_note: Records sharing one town point are spread evenly inside its OpenStreetMap outline (Nominatim reverse lookup); the original point is kept in source_lat/source_lon.
